description: One restarted HTTPS service with three isolated runner roots: compatible observations converge, duplicate retries are idempotent, one validator owns the lease, outage preserves native results, restart accepts queued retry, incompatible observations stay isolated, and wrong-scope, fork, stale, late, and tampered publications fail closed.

implementation.seam: existing central HTTPS handler, WCNCP routes, lease coordinator, and wrapper outbox/upload exercised together
implementation.topology: one server storage with restart plus runner A, B, and C isolated outboxes
implementation.timingNote: no synthetic timing counts as public value

coverage: runner A trusted observation and runner B compatible canonical wire observation both publish through the real HTTPS batch route
runner C duplicate retry converges without duplication
runner C offline item stays queued locally
two validators race with exactly one lease winner
outage upload stays queued with zero uploaded and native result preserved
restart accepts the queued exact retry and exact acknowledgement permits local deletion
wrong scope, fork, and tampered writes fail closed
